title: They exiled him 3 years ago. Today he came back.
look: cinematic film still, shot on ARRI Alexa with anamorphic lenses, shallow depth of field, moody teal and amber colour grade, film grain, photorealistic, vertical 9:16, no text, no people. The hero is the same horse in every shot: a huge jet-black Friesian-type stallion, long wavy black mane, a thin white scar across his left shoulder, the rival is a young dapple-grey stallion

shots.prompt: Aerial drone shot pushing in over a black sand beach in a storm, crashing white waves, sea fog, a lone black stallion standing far away at the water's edge
Extreme close-up of the black stallion's dark eye, rain drops on his lashes, slow blink, lightning reflected in the eye
Low angle at ground level, the black stallion's hooves stamping slowly into wet black sand, foam washing over them, slow motion
Slow dolly push-in on the black stallion's profile, long mane whipping in the storm wind, lightning flickers behind the clouds
Very low angle, the black stallion rears up on his hind legs against a huge lightning bolt in a dark sky, slow motion, rain
Side tracking shot at full speed, the black stallion gallops along the surf line of the black sand beach, spray flying, slow motion
Top-down drone shot following the black stallion galloping off the black beach towards towering jagged grey mountains and green valleys
Wide shot of a herd of wild horses grazing in a green alpine valley under jagged dolomite peaks, one by one they lift their heads and look up
Low wide shot, the black stallion appears on the ridge line above the valley, silhouetted against storm clouds, wind in his mane
Tight close-up of the young dapple-grey stallion, ears pinned back, nostrils flaring, staring straight ahead, tense stillness
The black stallion and the dapple-grey stallion rear up face to face and clash in an alpine meadow, dust and grass flying, slow motion
Close-up of the black stallion's head pushing forward, flared nostrils, steam from his breath, determined eye, slow motion
The dapple-grey stallion turns away and trots off down the valley, the black stallion stands still and watches, the herd behind him
Slow orbiting drone shot around the black stallion standing on a mountain ridge at golden hour, the herd of wild horses gathered behind him, clouds below the peaks
